classification: A research screens; not viability thresholds

oxygen_tolerance.meaning: numerical uncertainty allowance derived per organ from paired saved runs; no physiological grace interval

unresolved_requirements: recovery-linked oxygen-deficit thresholds for every tissue
respiratory drive, airway, ventilation-demand coupling and CO2 clearance
tissue oxygen accessibility and microvascular exchange
blood compatibility, endothelial injury and reperfusion injury
biological auxiliary self-demand calibration where applicable
first_violation_policy: pressure: first violating complete window; oxygen: first observed sample bracket, not exact onset
incomplete_horizon_policy: unobserved future is unknown; no infinite support or safe duration
